title.en: Dialogue: Choose the one with religion

intro.en: Ammar wants to get married and talks to his father. His father reminds him that real happiness comes from religion, not only money or beauty. Notice «ذاتُ مالٍ» (one who has wealth) and «ذاتُ الدِّين» (one who has religion).
intro.ur: Ammar shaadi karna chahta hai aur apne walid se baat karta hai. Walid use yaad dilate hain ke asli khushi deen se milti hai, sirf maal ya husn se nahi. Dhyan dein «ذاتُ مالٍ» (maal wali) aur «ذاتُ الدِّين» (deen wali) par.
intro.ar: يُريدُ عَمّارٌ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَ فَيَتَحَدَّثُ مَعَ أَبيهِ، فَيُذَكِّرُهُ أَبوهُ بِأَنَّ السَّعادَةَ الحَقيقِيَّةَ في الدِّينِ، وَلَيْسَتْ في المالِ أَوِ الجَمالِ فَقَطْ. لاحِظْ «ذاتُ مالٍ» وَ«ذاتُ الدِّينِ».

dialogue.ar: ما بِكَ يا عَمّارُ؟ أَراكَ قَلِقاً هَذِهِ الأَيّامَ.
dialogue.tr: mā bika yā ʿammāru? arāka qaliqan hādhihi l-'ayyma.
dialogue.en: What is wrong, Ammar? I see you worried these days.
dialogue.ur: Kya baat hai Ammar? Main aapko in dino pareshan dekh raha hoon.

dialogue.ar: بَدَأْتُ أُفَكِّرُ في الزَّواجِ يا أَبي، وَلَمْ أَلْتَقِ بَعْدُ بِالفَتاةِ الَّتي تُناسِبُني.
dialogue.tr: bada'tu ufakkiru fī z-zawji yā abī, walam altaqi baʿdu bil-fatāti llatī tunāsibunī.
dialogue.en: I have started thinking about marriage, father, and I have not yet met the girl who suits me.
dialogue.ur: Abbu, main shaadi ke baare mein sochne laga hoon aur abhi tak us ladki se nahi mila jo mujhe munasib ho.

dialogue.ar: لا تَقْلَقْ، فَالفَتَياتُ المُناسِباتُ كَثيراتٌ.
dialogue.tr: lā taqlaq, fal-fataytu l-munāsibātu kathīrātun.
dialogue.en: Do not worry, suitable girls are many.
dialogue.ur: Fikr mat karo, munasib ladkiyan bohat hain.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ في بالِكَ فَتاةٌ مُناسِبَةٌ يا أَبي؟
dialogue.tr: hal fī bālika fatātun munāsibatun yā abī?
dialogue.en: Do you have a suitable girl in mind, father?
dialogue.ur: Abbu, kya aapke zehen mein koi munasib ladki hai?

dialogue.ar: سُمَيَّةُ بِنْتُ يوسُفَ جارَتُنا، فَما رَأْيُكَ بِها؟
dialogue.tr: sumayyatu bintu yawsufa jāratunā, famā ra'yuka bihā?
dialogue.en: Sumayya, daughter of Yusuf, is our neighbour; what is your opinion of her?
dialogue.ur: Sumayya binte Yusuf humari parosan hain, aapki unke baare mein kya raaye hai?

dialogue.ar: هِيَ مِنْ أُسْرَةٍ فَقيرَةٍ، وَأَنا أُريدُ فَتاةً غَنِيَّةً.
dialogue.tr: hiya min usratin faqīratin, wa'anā urīdu fatātan ghaniyyatan.
dialogue.en: She is from a poor family, and I want a rich girl.
dialogue.ur: Woh ghareeb khandan se hain aur main ameer ladki chahta hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَماذا عَنْ لَمْياءَ بِنْتِ سَعيدٍ؟
dialogue.tr: wamādhā ʿan lamay'a binti saʿīdin?
dialogue.en: And what about Lamya, daughter of Said?
dialogue.ur: Aur Lamya binte Saeed ke baare mein kya khayal hai?

dialogue.ar: سَمِعْتُ أَنَّها جَميلَةٌ جِدّاً، لَكِنَّ حَسَبَها وَنَسَبَها لا أَعْرِفُهُما.
dialogue.tr: samiʿtu annahā jamīlatun jiddan, lakinna ḥasabahā wanasabahā lā aʿrifuhumā.
dialogue.en: I heard she is very beautiful, but I do not know her standing and lineage.
dialogue.ur: Suna hai woh bohat khoobsurat hain, lekin unke hasab nasab ke baare mein mujhe maloom nahi.

dialogue.ar: وَهُناكَ رِيمُ بِنْتُ خالِدٍ، وَهِيَ ذاتُ مالٍ وَحَسَبٍ وَنَسَبٍ.
dialogue.tr: wahunāka rīmu bintu khālidin, wahiya dhātu mālin waḥasabin wanasabin.
dialogue.en: And there is Reem, daughter of Khalid, who has wealth, standing and lineage.
dialogue.ur: Aur Reem binte Khalid hain, jo maal, hasab aur nasab wali hain.

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ هِيَ الفَتاةُ المُناسِبَةُ إِذَنْ!
dialogue.tr: hādhihi hiya l-fatātu l-munāsibatu idhan!
dialogue.en: This is the suitable girl, then!
dialogue.ur: To yehi munasib ladki hain!

dialogue.ar: هَلْ يَكْفيكَ المالُ وَالجَمالُ وَالنَّسَبُ؟ إِنَّها لا تَضْمَنُ لَكَ بَيْتاً سَعيداً.
dialogue.tr: hal yakfīka l-mālu wal-jamālu wan-nasabu? innahā lā taḍmanu laka baytan saʿīdan.
dialogue.en: Are money, beauty and lineage enough for you? They do not guarantee you a happy home.
dialogue.ur: Kya aapke liye maal, husn aur nasab kaafi hain? Yeh aapko khush ghar ki zamanat nahi dete.

dialogue.ar: وَكَيْفَ أَعْرِفُ الفَتاةَ الَّتي تُسْعِدُني يا أَبي؟
dialogue.tr: wakayfa aʿrifu l-fatāta llatī tusʿidunī yā abī?
dialogue.en: And how do I know the girl who will make me happy, father?
dialogue.ur: Abbu, mujhe kaise pata chalega ke kaun si ladki mujhe khush rakhegi?

dialogue.ar: اُنْظُرْ إِلَى الدِّينِ وَالخُلُقِ أَوَّلاً. قالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: «فَاظْفَرْ بِذاتِ الدِّينِ، تَرِبَتْ يَداكَ».
dialogue.tr: unẓur ilā d-dīni wal-khuluqi awwalan. qāla n-nabiyyu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam : fāẓfar bidhāti d-dīni, taribat yadāka.
dialogue.en: Look first at religion and character. The Prophet ﷺ said: 'So win the one with religion, may your hands be dusted.'
dialogue.ur: Pehle deen aur akhlaq dekho. Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: 'Deen wali ko hasil karo, tumhare haath khaak aalood hon.'

dialogue.ar: صَدَقْتَ يا أَبي، سَأَسْأَلُ عَنْ دينِها وَأَخْلاقِها.
dialogue.tr: ṣadaqta yā abī, sa'as'alu ʿan dīnihā wa'akhlāqihā.
dialogue.en: You are right, father; I will ask about her religion and character.
dialogue.ur: Aap ne sach kaha abbu, main unke deen aur akhlaq ke baare mein poochhunga.

q.en: What does the father say makes a person happy?
q.ur: Walid ke mutabiq insaan ko kya khush karta hai?
q.ar: ما الَّذي يَقولُ الأَبُ إِنَّهُ يُسْعِدُ الإِنْسانَ؟

q.en: Which word is the opposite of «جَمِيل» (beautiful)?
q.ur: «جَمِيل» ka ulta kaun sa lafz hai?
Hadees ke alfaz mukammal karein: «فَاظْفَرْ بِذاتِ ...»

title.en: Sounds: the long و and the soft و

intro.en: Two sounds of و. Waw of madd (long ُـو) follows a damma and is stretched, like دُور (dūr). Waw of liin (soft َـوْ) follows a fatha and has sukun, like حَوْل (ḥawl). Listen and repeat the Qur'an verses.
intro.ur: و ki do awaazein. Waaw-e-madd (ُـو) damma ke baad aati hai aur lambi parhi jati hai, jaise دُور (door). Waaw-e-leen (َـوْ) fatha ke baad aati hai aur us par sukoon hota hai, jaise حَوْل (hawl). Qur'an ki aayaat sunein aur dohraein.
intro.ar: لِلْواوِ صَوْتانِ: واوُ المَدِّ تَأْتي بَعْدَ الضَّمَّةِ وَتُمَدُّ، مِثْلَ دُور، وَواوُ اللِّينِ تَأْتي بَعْدَ الفَتْحَةِ وَتَكونُ ساكِنَةً، مِثْلَ حَوْل. اِسْتَمِعْ وَرَدِّدِ الآياتِ.

dialogue.ar: وَالطُّورِ وَكِتَابٍ مَّسْطُورٍ فِي رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ
dialogue.tr: waṭ-ṭūr, wa kitābin masṭūr, fī raqqin manshūr
dialogue.en: By the Mount, and a Book inscribed, on an unrolled scroll. (At-Tur 1-3)
dialogue.ur: Qasam hai Toor ki, aur likhi hui kitaab ki, khuli hui jhilli mein. (At-Toor 1-3)

dialogue.ar: وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَالرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
dialogue.tr: wa aṭīʿū llāha war-rasūla laʿallakum turḥamūn
dialogue.en: And obey Allah and the Messenger so that you may receive mercy. (Aal Imran 132)
dialogue.ur: Aur Allah aur Rasool ki itaa'at karo taake tum par raham kiya jaye. (Aal Imran 132)

dialogue.ar: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْبُرُوجِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْمَوْعُودِ
dialogue.tr: was-samāʾi dhātil-burūj, wal-yawmil-mawʿūd
dialogue.en: By the sky containing great stars, and by the promised Day. (Al-Buruj 1-2)
dialogue.ur: Qasam hai burjon wale aasman ki, aur wada kiye hue din ki. (Al-Burooj 1-2)

dialogue.ar: الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَآمَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍ
dialogue.tr: alladhī aṭʿamahum min jūʿin wa āmanahum min khawf
dialogue.en: Who fed them against hunger and secured them from fear. (Quraysh 4)
dialogue.ur: Jis ne unhein bhook mein khilaya aur khauf se amaan di. (Quraish 4)

q.en: The waw of madd comes after which vowel?
q.ur: Waaw-e-madd kis harkat ke baad aata hai?
q.ar: بَعْدَ أَيِّ حَرَكَةٍ تَأْتي واوُ المَدِّ؟

q.en: Which word has the waw of madd?

intro.en: Every noun is masculine (مُذَكَّر) or feminine (مُؤَنَّث). A common sign of the feminine is the round ta (ـة), like طَبِيب (doctor, m.) and طَبِيبَة (doctor, f.).
intro.ur: Har ism muzakkar (مُذَكَّر) ya muannas (مُؤَنَّث) hota hai. Muannas ki aam nishani gol ta (ـة) hai, jaise طَبِيب (doctor, mard) aur طَبِيبَة (doctor, aurat).
intro.ar: كُلُّ اسْمٍ إِمّا مُذَكَّرٌ وَإِمّا مُؤَنَّثٌ. وَمِنْ عَلاماتِ المُؤَنَّثِ الشّائِعَةِ التّاءُ المَرْبوطَةُ (ـة)، مِثْلَ: طَبيب (مُذَكَّرٌ) وَطَبيبَة (مُؤَنَّثٌ).

q.en: What is a common sign of the feminine?
q.ur: Muannas ki aam nishani kya hai?

title.ur: Sunna aur Bolna: Shaadi ke baare mein

intro.en: A listening exercise about two friends, Abdullah and Ahmad, and then speaking practice with a classmate about marriage in your country. The audio is on the slide; the questions use words you already know.
intro.ur: Do doston, Abdullah aur Ahmad, ke baare mein sunne ki mashq, phir apne sathi ke saath shaadi ke baare mein guftagu. Audio slide par maujood hai; sawaal aise alfaz mein hain jo aap jaante hain.
intro.ar: تَمْرينُ اسْتِماعٍ عَنْ صَديقَيْنِ هُما عَبْدُ اللهِ وَأَحْمَدُ، ثُمَّ تَدَرُّبٌ عَلى الكَلامِ مَعَ زَميلٍ عَنِ الزَّواجِ في بَلَدِكَ. الصَّوْتُ مَوْجودٌ في الشَّريحَةِ، وَالأَسْئِلَةُ بِكَلِماتٍ تَعْرِفُها.

q.en: How do you ask «When does a young man marry in your country?»
q.ur: «Aap ke mulk mein naujawan kab shaadi karta hai?» kaise poochenge?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ: مَتى يَتَزَوَّجُ الشّابُّ في بَلَدِكَ؟

q.ur: «ذاتُ دِين» kaisi ladki ko kehte hain?
Kaun sa lafz «kaise» ke liye hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةِ اسْتِفْهامٍ يُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ الطَّريقَةِ؟

title.en: Reading: Do problems happen between spouses?
title.ur: Parhna: Kya miyan biwi mein masle hote hain?

intro.en: A short reading about married life. It is full of good things, but small problems can appear, and the way to success is talking calmly. Read slowly, sentence by sentence.
intro.ur: Shaadi shuda zindagi par ek mukhtasar matan. Isme bohat bhalai hai, lekin chhote masle bhi aa sakte hain aur kamyabi ka raasta pur-sukoon baat cheet hai. Aahista aahista, jumla ba jumla parhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ قَصيرٌ عَنِ الحَياةِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ: فيها خَيْرٌ كَثيرٌ، وَقَدْ تَظْهَرُ فيها مُشْكِلاتٌ صَغيرَةٌ، وَسَبيلُ النَّجاحِ هُوَ الحِوارُ الهادِئُ. اِقْرَأْ بِبُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً.

dialogue.ar: الزَّواجُ بِدايَةُ مَرْحَلَةٍ جَديدَةٍ في حَياةِ الرَّجُلِ وَالمَرْأَةِ، وَفيهِ سَعادَةٌ كَبيرَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: az-zawju bidāyatu marḥalatin jadīdatin fī ḥayti r-rajuli wal-mar'ati, wafīhi saʿādatun kabīratun.
dialogue.en: Marriage is the beginning of a new stage in the life of the man and the woman, and it has great happiness.
dialogue.ur: Shaadi mard aur aurat ki zindagi ke ek naye marhale ka aaghaz hai aur ismein bari khushi hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلَكِنَّ الخِلافاتِ قَدْ تَظْهَرُ بَيْنَ الزَّوْجَيْنِ، كَما تَظْهَرُ بَيْنَ كُلِّ النّاسِ.
dialogue.tr: walakinna l-khilāfāti qad taẓharu bayna z-zawjayni, kamā taẓharu bayna kulli n-nāsi.
dialogue.en: But disagreements may appear between the spouses, as they appear between all people.
dialogue.ur: Lekin miyan biwi ke darmiyan ikhtilaf ho sakte hain, jaise sab logon ke darmiyan hote hain.

dialogue.ar: يَعْتَقِدُ بَعْضُ الشُّبّانِ أَنَّ الزَّواجَ لا تَدْخُلُهُ المُشْكِلاتُ أَبَداً.
dialogue.tr: yaʿtaqidu baʿḍu sh-shubbāni anna z-zawja lā tadkhuluhu l-mushkilātu abadan.
dialogue.en: Some young men believe that marriage is never entered by problems.
dialogue.ur: Kuch naujawan samajhte hain ke shaadi mein kabhi masle nahi aate.

dialogue.ar: وَالحَقيقَةُ أَنَّ لِكُلِّ مُشْكِلَةٍ حَلّاً إِذا فَكَّرَ الزَّوْجانِ فيها مَعاً.
dialogue.tr: wal-ḥaqīqatu anna likulli mushkilatin ḥallan idhā fakkara z-zawjāni fīhā maʿan.
dialogue.en: The truth is that every problem has a solution if the two spouses think about it together.
dialogue.ur: Haqeeqat yeh hai ke har masle ka hal hai agar miyan biwi milkar uspar sochein.

dialogue.ar: فَكُلٌّ مِنْهُما نَشَأَ في بَيْتٍ مُخْتَلِفٍ، وَعاشَ طُفولَةً مُخْتَلِفَةً، وَلَهُ شَخْصِيَّةٌ خاصَّةٌ.
dialogue.tr: fakullun minhumā nasha'a fī baytin mukhtalifin, waʿāsha ṭufūlatan mukhtalifatan, walahu shakhṣiyyatun khāṣṣatun.
dialogue.en: Each of them grew up in a different home, lived a different childhood, and has a personality of his own.
dialogue.ur: Dono alag ghar mein pale, alag bachpan guzaara aur har ek ki apni shakhsiyat hai.

dialogue.ar: تَقولُ الزَّوْجَةُ أَحْياناً: زَوْجي يَعودُ مُتْعَباً، وَلا يَجِدُ وَقْتاً لِيَسْمَعَني.
dialogue.tr: taqūlu z-zawjatu aḥaynan: zawjī yaʿūdu mutʿaban, walā yajidu waqtan liyasmaʿanī.
dialogue.en: The wife sometimes says: my husband comes home tired and finds no time to listen to me.
dialogue.ur: Biwi kabhi kehti hai: mere shauhar thake hue aate hain aur mujhe sunne ke liye waqt nahi paate.

dialogue.ar: وَيَقولُ الزَّوْجُ: زَوْجَتي تَهْتَمُّ بِأَشْياءَ صَغيرَةٍ، وَتَغْضَبُ بِسُرْعَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: wayaqūlu z-zawju: zawjatī tahtammu bi'ashay'a ṣaghīratin, wataghḍabu bisurʿatin.
dialogue.en: And the husband says: my wife cares about small things and gets angry quickly.
dialogue.ur: Aur shauhar kehta hai: meri biwi chhoti chhoti baaton ka khayal karti hai aur jaldi naraaz ho jati hai.

dialogue.ar: وَسَبيلُ النَّجاحِ أَنْ يَجْلِسا مَعاً وَيَتَحَدَّثا بِهُدوءٍ، فَالحِوارُ يُبْعِدُهُما عَنِ الطَّلاقِ.
dialogue.tr: wasabīlu n-najāḥi an yajlisā maʿan wayataḥaddathā bihudū'in, fal-ḥiawru yubʿiduhumā ʿani ṭ-ṭalāqi.
dialogue.en: The way to success is to sit together and talk calmly, for dialogue keeps them away from divorce.
dialogue.ur: Kamyabi ka raasta yeh hai ke dono saath baith kar sukoon se baat karein, kyunke baat cheet unhein talaq se door rakhti hai.

q.en: According to the text, married life is…

options: full of good, but problems may appear
options_ar: مَليئَةٌ بِالخَيْرِ وَقَدْ تَظْهَرُ فيها مُشْكِلاتٌ

q.en: What do some young people think about married life?
q.ur: Kuch naujawan shaadi shuda zindagi ke baare mein kya sochte hain?
q.ar: ماذا يَظُنُّ بَعْضُ الشَّبابِ عَنِ الحَياةِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ؟

options: That it is a long journey
That it is only about money
That it is only for the old

q.en: What is the way to success in married life?
q.ar: ما طَريقُ النَّجاحِ في الحَياةِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ؟

intro.en: A sentence is of two kinds. A nominal sentence (جُمْلَة اسْمِيَّة) starts with a noun, like «المَدْرَسَةُ كَبِيرَةٌ» (the school is big). A verbal sentence (جُمْلَة فِعْلِيَّة) starts with a verb, like «أُرِيدُ الزَّواجَ» (I want marriage).
intro.ur: Jumle ki do qismein hain. Jumla ismiyya (جُمْلَة اسْمِيَّة) ism se shuru hota hai, jaise «المَدْرَسَةُ كَبِيرَةٌ» (school bara hai). Jumla fi'liyya (جُمْلَة فِعْلِيَّة) fe'l se shuru hota hai, jaise «أُرِيدُ الزَّواجَ» (main shadi chahta hoon).
intro.ar: الجُمْلَةُ نَوْعانِ: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ تَبْدَأُ بِاسْمٍ، مِثْلَ «المَدْرَسَةُ كَبيرَةٌ»، وَجُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ تَبْدَأُ بِفِعْلٍ، مِثْلَ «أُريدُ الزَّواجَ».

vocab.ur: wo maal aur husn chahta hai

q.ur: Jumla ismiyya kis se shuru hota hai?
Jumla fi'liyya kis se shuru hota hai?
«ذَهَبَ الطّالِبُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ» kaisa jumla hai?

title.en: Dialogue: Staying up late on the phone

intro.en: Suad visits her neighbour, who is worried because her daughter Lamya has changed. Suad listens and gives good advice. Notice the useful phrases: «الحَمْدُ للهِ عَلَى سَلامَتِكِ», «شَفاكِ اللهُ», «بِإِذْنِ اللهِ» and «جَزاكِ اللهُ خَيْراً».
intro.ur: Suad apni parosan se milne aati hai jo pareshan hai kyunke uski beti Lamya badal gayi hai. Suad sunti hai aur achha mashwara deti hai. Mufeed alfaaz par dhyan dein: «الحَمْدُ للهِ عَلَى سَلامَتِكِ»، «شَفاكِ اللهُ»، «بِإِذْنِ اللهِ» aur «جَزاكِ اللهُ خَيْراً».
intro.ar: تَزورُ سُعادُ جارَتَها القَلِقَةَ لِأَنَّ ابْنَتَها لَمْياءَ تَغَيَّرَتْ، فَتَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْها وَتَنْصَحُها. لاحِظْ هَذِهِ العِباراتِ: «الحَمْدُ للهِ عَلَى سَلامَتِكِ»، «شَفاكِ اللهُ»، «بِإِذْنِ اللهِ»، «جَزاكِ اللهُ خَيْراً».

dialogue.ar: الحَمْدُ للهِ عَلَى سَلامَتِكِ يا أُمَّ لَمْياءَ! سَمِعْتُ أَنَّكِ كُنْتِ مَريضَةً.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥamdu llhi ʿalā salāmatiki yā umma lamay'a! samiʿtu annaki kunti marīḍatan.
dialogue.en: Thank God for your safety, Umm Lamya! I heard you were ill.
dialogue.ur: Umm Lamya, Allah ka shukr hai ke aap salamat hain! Maine suna aap bimar thin.

dialogue.ar: شَفاني اللهُ، أَنا بِخَيْرٍ الآنَ. لَكِنَّ هَمّاً آخَرَ يُتْعِبُني.
dialogue.tr: shafānī llāh, anā bikhayrin al-'āna. lakinna hamman ākhara yutʿibunī.
dialogue.en: Allah cured me, I am fine now. But another worry tires me.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne shifa di, ab main theek hoon. Lekin ek aur fikr mujhe thakaye hue hai.

dialogue.ar: ماذا هُناكَ؟ تَكَلَّمي، فَأَنا أَسْمَعُكِ.
dialogue.tr: mādhā hunāka? takallamī, fa'anā asmaʿuki.
dialogue.en: What is it? Speak, I am listening to you.
dialogue.ur: Kya baat hai? Boliye, main sun rahi hoon.

dialogue.ar: ابْنَتي لَمْياءُ لَمْ تَعُدْ كَما كانَتْ.
dialogue.tr: bnatī lamay'u lam taʿud kamā kānat.
dialogue.en: My daughter Lamya is no longer as she was.
dialogue.ur: Meri beti Lamya ab waisi nahi rahi jaisi pehle thi.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ كانَتْ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa kānat?
dialogue.en: How was she?
dialogue.ur: Woh kaisi thi?

dialogue.ar: كانَتْ مُؤَدَّبَةً وَمُطيعَةً وَطَيِّبَةً مَعَ الجَميعِ طَوالَ سَنَواتٍ.
dialogue.tr: kānat mu'addabatan wamuṭīʿatan waṭayyibatan maʿa l-jamīʿi ṭawla sanawtin.
dialogue.en: She was well-mannered, obedient and kind to everyone for years.
dialogue.ur: Woh saalon tak bamaqsad, farmanbardar aur sab ke saath narm dil thi.

dialogue.ar: وَكَيْفَ تَغَيَّرَتْ؟
dialogue.tr: wakayfa taghayyarat?
dialogue.en: And how has she changed?
dialogue.ur: Aur woh kaise badal gayi?

dialogue.ar: أَصْبَحَتْ مُهْمِلَةً في دُروسِها، لا تَهْتَمُّ بِالبَيْتِ، وَهِيَ عَنيدَةٌ إِذا نَصَحْتُها.
dialogue.tr: aṣbaḥat muhmilatan fī durūsihā, lā tahtammu bil-bayti, wahiya ʿanīdatun idhā naṣaḥtuhā.
dialogue.en: She became neglectful of her lessons, does not care about the house, and is stubborn when I advise her.
dialogue.ur: Woh parhai mein laparwah ho gayi, ghar ka khayal nahi rakhti aur jab main samjhaon to ziddi ho jati hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ تَعْرِفينَ السَّبَبَ؟
dialogue.tr: wahal taʿrifīna s-sababa?
dialogue.en: And do you know the reason?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap wajah jaanti hain?

dialogue.ar: رُبَّما لِأَنَّها صارَتْ تَسْهَرُ كَثيراً أَمامَ الهاتِفِ، وَتَنامُ مُتَأَخِّرَةً.
dialogue.tr: rubbamā li'annahā ṣārat tasharu kathīran amāma l-hātifi, watanāmu muta'akhkhiratan.
dialogue.en: Perhaps because she began to stay up a lot in front of the phone and sleeps late.
dialogue.ur: Shayad isliye ke woh phone ke saamne bohat raat jaagne lagi hai aur der se soti hai.

dialogue.ar: هَذا أَمْرٌ مُهِمٌّ. هَلْ تَكَلَّمْتِ مَعَها بِهُدوءٍ؟
dialogue.tr: hādhā amrun muhimmun. hal takallamti maʿahā bihudū'in?
dialogue.en: That is an important matter. Did you talk to her calmly?
dialogue.ur: Yeh ahem baat hai. Kya aapne unse sukoon se baat ki?

dialogue.ar: تَكَلَّمْتُ كَثيراً، وَلَكِنْ بِصَوْتٍ عالٍ، فَزادَتْ عِناداً.
dialogue.tr: takallamtu kathīran, walakin biṣawtin ʿālin, fazādat ʿinādan.
dialogue.en: I talked a lot, but in a loud voice, and she became more stubborn.
dialogue.ur: Maine bohat baat ki, lekin oonchi awaaz mein, to woh aur ziddi ho gayi.

dialogue.ar: جَرِّبي الكَلامَ اللَّطيفَ، وَحَدِّدي لَها وَقْتاً لِلنَّوْمِ.
dialogue.tr: jarribī l-kalāma l-laṭīfa, waḥaddidī lahā waqtan lilnnawmi.
dialogue.en: Try gentle words, and set a bedtime for her.
dialogue.ur: Narmi se baat karke dekhein aur uske sone ka waqt muqarrar kar dein.

dialogue.ar: سَأَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ بِإِذْنِ اللهِ، فَأَنا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَراها سَعيدَةً.
dialogue.tr: sa'afʿalu dhālika bi'idhni llāh, fa'anā uḥibbu an arāhā saʿīdatan.
dialogue.en: I will do that, God willing, for I love to see her happy.
dialogue.ur: Main aisa hi karungi, Allah ke hukm se, kyunke mujhe use khush dekhna pasand hai.

dialogue.ar: إِذَنْ سَتَعودُ لَمْياءُ كَما كانَتْ، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: idhan sataʿūdu lamay'u kamā kānat, in shā'a llāh.
dialogue.en: Then Lamya will return as she was, God willing.
dialogue.ur: To Lamya waisi hi ho jayegi jaisi pehle thi, inshaAllah.

dialogue.ar: جَزاكِ اللهُ خَيْراً يا سُعادُ.
dialogue.tr: jazāki llāh khayran yā suʿādu.
dialogue.en: May Allah reward you with good, Suad.
dialogue.ur: Allah aapko jazaye khair de Suad.

vocab.ur: Allah aap ko jazaye khair de
Allah ka shukar hai aap salamat hain

vocab.tr: innā lillāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūn
vocab.en: we belong to Allah and to Him we return
vocab.ur: hum Allah ke hain aur usi ki taraf lautne wale hain

q.ur: Ammi ko sab se pehle kis baat ki fikr hai?

options: She wants to buy a car

q.ur: Lamya ne kya karna shuru kiya?

options: staying up late in front of the phone
Speak gently and set a bedtime
options_ar: أَنْ تَتَكَلَّمَ بِلُطْفٍ وَتُحَدِّدَ وَقْتاً لِلنَّوْمِ

q.en: What does Suad say will happen then?
q.ur: Suad ke mutabiq phir kya hoga?
q.ar: ماذا تَقولُ سُعادُ إِنَّهُ سَيَحْدُثُ حينَئِذٍ؟

options: Lamya will return as she was

intro.en: A silent ta (تْ) is added to the end of a past verb when the doer is feminine. Example: «جاءَ زَوْجٌ» (a husband came) becomes «جاءَتْ زَوْجَةٌ» (a wife came). The verb changes, the rest stays.
intro.ur: Jab fa'il muannas ho to maazi fe'l ke aakhir mein sakin ta (تْ) lagti hai. Misaal: «جاءَ زَوْجٌ» (shauhar aaya) se «جاءَتْ زَوْجَةٌ» (biwi aayi). Sirf fe'l badalta hai, baqi waisa hi rehta hai.
intro.ar: نُضيفُ تاءً ساكِنَةً (تْ) إِلى آخِرِ الفِعْلِ الماضي إِذا كانَ الفاعِلُ مُؤَنَّثاً. مِثالٌ: «جاءَ زَوْجٌ» تَصيرُ «جاءَتْ زَوْجَةٌ». يَتَغَيَّرُ الفِعْلُ وَيَبْقى الباقي.

q.en: The silent ta (تْ) is added to…
q.ur: Saakin ta kis ke saath lagti hai?

q.en: Which verb has the silent ta?
q.ur: Kis fe'l mein saakin ta hai?
«فَحَصَتْ طَبِيبَةُ القَلْبِ المَرِيضَةَ» Kis ne mo'ayna kiya?
q.ar: «فَحَصَتْ طَبِيبَةُ القَلْبِ المَرِيضَةَ». مَنِ الَّتي فَحَصَتْ؟

q.en: «قَرَأَتِ البِنْتُ الصَّحِيفَةَ». The ta tells us the reader is…
q.ur: Ta bata rahi hai parhne wala kaun hai:
q.ar: «قَرَأَتِ البِنْتُ الصَّحيفَةَ». التّاءُ تَدُلُّنا عَلى أَنَّ القارِئَ…

title.en: Listening and speaking about the family
title.ur: Sunna aur Bolna: Khandan ke baare mein

intro.en: A listening text about a man's family (children, wife, relatives), then speaking practice about husbands and wives at home. The questions use family words: sons, daughters, paternal aunt (عَمَّة) and maternal aunt (خالَة).
intro.ur: Ek shakhs ke khandan (bachon, biwi, rishtedaron) ke baare mein sunne ka matn, phir ghar mein miyan biwi ke baare mein guftagu. Sawaal khandan ke alfaz par hain: bete, betiyan, phuphi (عَمَّة) aur khala (خالَة).
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلاسْتِماعِ عَنْ أُسْرَةِ رَجُلٍ (أَبْناءٌ وَزَوْجَةٌ وَأَقارِبُ)، ثُمَّ تَدَرُّبٌ عَلى الكَلامِ عَنِ الأَزْواجِ في البَيْتِ. الأَسْئِلَةُ بِكَلِماتِ الأُسْرَةِ: أَبْناء، بَنات، عَمَّة (أُخْتُ الأَبِ)، خالَة (أُخْتُ الأُمِّ).

options: he stays up outside the home

title.en: Reading: The family, past and present

intro.en: A reading about how the family has changed. In the past the big family lived in one house; today the small family (husband, wife and children) is common. Before reading, think: is your family big or small?
intro.ur: Is matn mein dekhein ke khandan kaise badla. Pehle bara khandan ek ghar mein rehta tha; aaj chhota khandan (shauhar, biwi, bachche) aam hai. Parhne se pehle sochein: aap ka khandan bara hai ya chhota?
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ عَنْ تَغَيُّرِ الأُسْرَةِ: كانَتِ الأُسْرَةُ الكَبيرَةُ تَسْكُنُ في بَيْتٍ واحِدٍ، وَاليَوْمَ شاعَتِ الأُسْرَةُ الصَّغيرَةُ (الزَّوْجُ وَالزَّوْجَةُ وَالأَوْلادُ). فَكِّرْ قَبْلَ القِراءَةِ: هَلْ أُسْرَتُكَ كَبيرَةٌ أَمْ صَغيرَةٌ؟

dialogue.ar: تَغَيَّرَتِ الأُسْرَةُ في مُجْتَمَعِنا كَثيراً بَيْنَ الماضي وَالحاضِرِ.
dialogue.tr: taghayyarati l-'usratu fī mujtamaʿinā kathīran bayna l-māḍī wal-ḥāḍiri.
dialogue.en: The family in our society has changed a lot between the past and the present.
dialogue.ur: Hamare muashre mein khandan maazi aur haal ke darmiyan bohat badal gaya hai.

dialogue.ar: فَفي الماضي كانَ البَيْتُ الواحِدُ يَضُمُّ الجَدَّ وَالجَدَّةَ وَالأَبْناءَ وَالأَحْفادَ.
dialogue.tr: fafī l-māḍī kāna l-baytu l-awḥidu yaḍummu l-jadda wal-jaddata wal-'abnā'a wal-'aḥfāda.
dialogue.en: In the past one house included the grandfather, the grandmother, the sons and the grandchildren.
dialogue.ur: Pehle ek hi ghar mein dada, dadi, bete aur pote sab shamil hote the.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا اليَوْمَ فَأَصْبَحَ مُعْظَمُ الأَفْرادِ يَسْكُنونَ في شَقَّةٍ صَغيرَةٍ مَعَ أَبيهِمْ وَأُمِّهِمْ فَقَطْ.
dialogue.tr: ammā l-yawma fa'aṣbaḥa muʿẓamu l-'afrādi yaskunūna fī shaqqatin ṣaghīratin maʿa abīhim wa'ummihim faqaṭ.
dialogue.en: Today most people live in a small flat with only their father and mother.
dialogue.ur: Aaj zyadatar log ek chhote flat mein sirf apne walid aur walida ke saath rehte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ الآباءُ قَديماً يَعْمَلونَ قَريباً مِنَ البَيْتِ، فَيَجْلِسونَ مَعَ أَطْفالِهِمْ كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: wakāna l-'ābā'u qadīman yaʿmalūna qarīban mina l-bayti, fayajlisūna maʿa aṭfālihim kathīran.
dialogue.en: In the past fathers worked near the house, so they sat with their children a lot.
dialogue.ur: Pehle walid ghar ke qareeb kaam karte the, isliye bachchon ke saath bohat baithte the.

dialogue.ar: وَالآنَ يُغادِرُ الأَبُ البَيْتَ في الصَّباحِ الباكِرِ، وَلا يَعودُ إِلّا في المَساءِ.
dialogue.tr: wal-'āna yughādiru l-'abu l-bayta fī ṣ-ṣabāḥi l-bākiri, walā yaʿūdu illā fī l-masā'i.
dialogue.en: Now the father leaves the house early in the morning and returns only in the evening.
dialogue.ur: Ab walid subah sawere ghar se nikalte hain aur shaam hi ko lautte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَتَقْضي الأُمُّ نَهارَها وَحْدَها، تَنْتَظِرُ عَوْدَةَ أَوْلادِها مِنَ المَدْرَسَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wataqḍī l-'ummu nahārahā waḥdahā, tantaẓiru ʿawdata awlādihā mina l-madrasati.
dialogue.en: The mother spends her day alone, waiting for her children to come back from school.
dialogue.ur: Walida apna din akeli guzaarti hai aur bachchon ke school se lautne ka intezar karti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَفي بَعْضِ البُيوتِ تَعْمَلُ الأُمُّ خارِجَ البَيْتِ أَيْضاً، فَتَعودُ مُتْعَبَةً.
dialogue.tr: wafī baʿḍi l-buayawti taʿmalu l-'ummu khārija l-bayti ayḍan, fataʿūdu mutʿabatan.
dialogue.en: In some houses the mother also works outside the home, so she comes back tired.
dialogue.ur: Kuch gharon mein walida ghar se bahar bhi kaam karti hai, to woh thaki hui lautti hai.

dialogue.ar: فَلا تَجِدُ قُوَّةً لِلنَّظافَةِ، وَلا وَقْتاً لِلْجُلوسِ مَعَ الأُسْرَةِ في اللَّيْلِ.
dialogue.tr: falā tajidu quwwatan lilnnaẓāfati, walā waqtan liljulūsi maʿa l-'usrati fī l-layli.
dialogue.en: She finds no strength for cleaning and no time to sit with the family at night.
dialogue.ur: Use safai ki taaqat nahi milti aur raat ko ghar walon ke saath baithne ka waqt bhi nahi milta.

q.en: In the past, the big family…

q.ur: Chhote khandan mein kaun hota hai?

q.en: Why do fathers see their children only a little?
q.ur: Walid bachon ko kam kyun dekhte hain?
q.ar: لِماذا لا يَرى الآباءُ أَوْلادَهُمْ إِلّا قَليلاً؟

options: They spend most of the time at work

intro.en: A pronoun (ضَمِير) stands in for a noun. It is for the speaker (مُتَكَلِّم), the one spoken to (مُخاطَب) or the one spoken about (غائِب). Example: أَنا (I), أَنْتَ (you, m.), هُوَ (he).
intro.ur: Zameer (ضَمِير) ism ki jagah aata hai. Ye mutakallim (bolne wala), mukhatab (jis se baat ho) ya ghaib (jis ka zikr ho) ke liye hota hai. Misaal: أَنا (main), أَنْتَ (tum, mard), هُوَ (wo, mard).
intro.ar: الضَّميرُ كَلِمَةٌ تَقومُ مَقامَ الاسْمِ. وَهُوَ لِلْمُتَكَلِّمِ أَوْ لِلْمُخاطَبِ أَوْ لِلْغائِبِ. أَمْثِلَةٌ: أَنا، أَنْتَ، هُوَ.

q.ur: «Main» ke liye kaun sa zameer hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ ضَميرٍ يَدُلُّ عَلى المُتَكَلِّمِ المُفْرَدِ؟

q.ur: «Hum» ke liye kaun sa zameer hai?

q.en: Which pronoun is for «you» (to a group of men)?
q.ur: Mardon ke group se «tum» ke liye?

intro.en: Practise writing five sentences about a picture and a short topic about married life or the family. You also learn punctuation marks: the full stop, question mark, exclamation mark, comma, quotation marks and colon.
intro.ur: Tasweer ke baare mein paanch jumle likhne ki mashq aur shadi-shuda zindagi ya khandan par mazmoon. Saath hi alamat-e-tarqeem: full stop, sawaliya nishan, tajjub ka nishan, comma, iqtibas aur colon.
intro.ar: تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى كِتابَةِ خَمْسِ جُمَلٍ عَنْ صورَةٍ وَمَوْضوعٍ قَصيرٍ عَنِ الحَياةِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ أَوِ الأُسْرَةِ. وَتَتَعَلَّمُ عَلاماتِ التَّرْقيمِ: النُّقْطَةَ، وَالاسْتِفْهامَ، وَالتَّعَجُّبَ، وَالفاصِلَةَ، وَالتَّنْصيصَ، وَالنُّقْطَتَيْنِ.

q.ur: Sawal ke aakhir mein kaun si nishani aati hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عَلامَةٍ تُوضَعُ في نِهايَةِ السُّؤالِ؟

q.en: Which mark shows surprise (like «يا لَها مِنْ نَصِيحَةٍ!»)?
q.ur: Tajjub kis nishan se zaahir hota hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عَلامَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى الدَّهْشَةِ في «يا لَها مِنْ نَصيحَةٍ!»؟

q.en: A topic from the unit: «الحَياةُ الزَّوْجِيَّةُ» means…

title.en: Calligraphy and dictation: the moving ta

intro.en: Copy a Hadith in Naskh script: «A Muslim may not shun his brother for more than three nights.» Then learn that the moving ta comes in two shapes: the round ta (ـة / ة) and the open ta (ت).
intro.ur: Naskh khat mein ek hadees naql karein: «Kisi Muslim ke liye jaiz nahin ke apne bhai se teen raat se zyada tarke-taalluq rakhe.» Phir seekhein ke ta mutaharrika ki do shakalein hain: gol ta (ـة / ة) aur khuli ta (ت).
intro.ar: اِنْسَخْ حَديثاً بِخَطِّ النَّسْخِ: «لا يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلاثِ لَيالٍ». ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمْ أَنَّ التّاءَ المُتَحَرِّكَةَ لَها شَكْلانِ: التّاءُ المَرْبوطَةُ (ـة / ة) وَالتّاءُ المَفْتوحَةُ (ت).

dialogue.ar: لا يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلاثِ لَيالٍ. (حَدِيثٌ شَرِيفٌ)
dialogue.tr: lā yaḥillu limuslimin an yahjura akhāhu fawqa thalāthi layāl
dialogue.en: It is not lawful for a Muslim to shun his brother for more than three nights. (Hadith)
dialogue.ur: Kisi Muslim ke liye jaiz nahin ke apne bhai se teen raat se zyada tarke-taalluq kare. (Hadees)

q.en: What are the two shapes of the moving ta?
Which word ends with the round ta?
q.ur: Kis lafz ke aakhir mein gol ta hai?

q.en: Which word has the open ta (ت)?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein khuli ta (ت) hai?
«طَبِيبات» ki jama kis ta se likhi jati hai?

q.en: What does the Hadith say a Muslim may not do for more than three nights?
q.ur: Hadees ke mutabiq kya teen raat se zyada jaiz nahin?
q.ar: ماذا لا يَحِلُّ لِلْمُسْلِمِ أَنْ يَفْعَلَ فَوْقَ ثَلاثِ لَيالٍ بِحَسَبِ الحَديثِ؟
